description: This file defines the SbPlayerTestFixture class and related nested classes and structures for testing media player functionality within the starboard namespace. It includes methods for managing media samples, handling player state, and interfacing with external components like graphics context providers.

classes.name: SbPlayerTestFixture
classes.description: A class for setting up and managing media player tests, including sample management, state synchronization, and callback handling.

classes.name: GroupedSamples
classes.description: Encapsulates grouped audio and video samples for testing purposes.

classes.name: GroupedSamplesIterator
classes.description: Forward declaration for iterator over grouped samples (not detailed in the header).

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks the media player to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes grouped audio/video samples to the player, handling EOS and data availability.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerPresenting
methods.description: Blocks until the player reaches the presenting state.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerEndOfStream
methods.description: Blocks until the end of stream state is reached.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Returns the current media playback time.

methods.name: SetAudioWriteDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for writing audio data.

methods.name: HasAudio
methods.description: Checks if audio data is available.

methods.name: HasVideo
methods.description: Checks if video data is available.

methods.name: GetAudioSampleTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of a specific audio sample.

methods.name: ConvertDurationToAudioBufferCount
methods.description: Converts a duration to the number of audio buffers.

methods.name: ConvertDurationToVideoBufferCount
methods.description: Converts a duration to the number of video buffers.
